from machine import Pin, ADC, PWM
from time import sleep
rouge = Pin(5, Pin.OUT)
verte = PWM(Pin(19), freq=1000)

    valeur = pot.read()

        if valeur < 1000:
            verte.duty(1023)
            sleep(0.5)
            verte.duty(0)
            sleep(0.5)

            verte.duty(valeur // 4)
            print("PWM variable")
        else:
            verte.duty(1023)
            print("LED MAX")
    else:
        rouge.on()
        verte.duty(0)
        print("SYSTEME OFF")
    sleep(0.1)

verte = PWM(Pin(19), freq=1000)
bouton = Pin(18, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_DOWN)
buzzer = Pin(23, Pin.OUT)
pir = Pin(27, Pin.IN)
pot = ADC(Pin(34)); pot.atten(ADC.ATTN_11DB)
ldr = ADC(Pin(35)); ldr.atten(ADC.ATTN_11DB)
servo = PWM(Pin(26), freq=50)
dht = DHT22(Pin(4))
alarme = False
mouvement_alarme = False
dernier_dht = ticks_ms() - 2000

def trois_bips():
    for i in range(3):
        buzzer.on(); sleep(0.2)
        buzzer.off(); sleep(0.2)

while True:
    valeur = pot.read()
    lumiere = ldr.read()
    mouvement = pir.value()
    print("ADC =", valeur, "LDR =", lumiere, "PIR =", mouvement)
    if ticks_diff(ticks_ms(), dernier_dht) >= 2000:
        dernier_dht = ticks_ms()
        try:
            dht.measure()
            temperature = dht.temperature()
            humidite = dht.humidity()
            print("Temperature =", temperature, "C")
            print("Humidite =", humidite, "%")
            if temperature > 30:
                print("TEMPERATURE ELEVEE")
        except OSError:
            print("Erreur lecture DHT22")
    if bouton.value() == 1:
        rouge.off()
        if valeur < 1000:
            servo.duty(26)
            verte.duty(1023)
            sleep(0.5)
            verte.duty(0)
            sleep(0.5)
        elif valeur < 2000:
            servo.duty(51)
            verte.duty(valeur // 4)
        elif valeur < 3000:
            servo.duty(77)
            verte.duty(valeur // 4)
        else:
            servo.duty(128)
            if valeur == 3000:
                verte.duty(valeur // 4)
            else:
                verte.duty(1023)
    else:
        servo.duty(26)
        verte.duty(0)
        if lumiere < 2000:
            rouge.on()
        else:
            rouge.off()
    if bouton.value() == 1 and valeur > 3000:
        if alarme == False:
            print("ALARME POTENTIOMETRE")
            trois_bips()
            alarme = True
    else:
        alarme = False
    if mouvement == 1 and lumiere < 2000:
        if mouvement_alarme == False:
            print("MOUVEMENT - NUIT")
            trois_bips()
            mouvement_alarme = True
    else:
        mouvement_alarme = False
    sleep(0.1)

from machine import Pin, ADC, PWM, I2C
from time import sleep, ticks_ms, ticks_diff
from dht import DHT22
from ssd1306 import SSD1306_I2C

rouge = Pin(5, Pin.OUT)
verte = PWM(Pin(19), freq=1000)
bouton = Pin(18, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_DOWN)
buzzer = Pin(23, Pin.OUT)
pir = Pin(27, Pin.IN)

ldr = ADC(Pin(35)); ldr.atten(ADC.ATTN_11DB)
servo = PWM(Pin(26), freq=50)
dht = DHT22(Pin(4))
i2c = I2C(0, scl=Pin(22), sda=Pin(21))
oled = SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)

alarme = False
mouvement_alarme = False
temperature = 0
humidite = 0
dernier_dht = ticks_ms() - 2000

def trois_bips():
    for i in range(3):
        buzzer.on(); sleep(0.2)
        buzzer.off(); sleep(0.2)

while True:
    valeur = pot.read()
    lumiere = ldr.read()
    mouvement = pir.value()
    actif = bouton.value()
    if ticks_diff(ticks_ms(), dernier_dht) >= 2000:
        dernier_dht = ticks_ms()
        try:
            dht.measure()
            temperature = dht.temperature()
            humidite = dht.humidity()
        except OSError:
            print("Erreur DHT22")
    if actif == 1:
        rouge.off()
        if valeur < 1000:
            servo.duty(26)
            verte.duty(1023)
            sleep(0.5)
            verte.duty(0)
            sleep(0.5)
        elif valeur < 2000:
            servo.duty(51)
            verte.duty(valeur // 4)
        elif valeur < 3000:
            servo.duty(77)
            verte.duty(valeur // 4)
        else:
            servo.duty(128)
            if valeur == 3000:
                verte.duty(valeur // 4)
            else:
                verte.duty(1023)
    else:
        servo.duty(26)
        verte.duty(0)
        if lumiere < 2000:
            rouge.on()
        else:
            rouge.off()
    if actif == 1 and valeur > 3000:
        if alarme == False:
            print("ALARME POT")
            trois_bips()
            alarme = True
    else:
        alarme = False
    if mouvement == 1 and lumiere < 2000:
        if mouvement_alarme == False:
            print("MOUVEMENT DETECTE")
            trois_bips()
            mouvement_alarme = True
    else:
        mouvement_alarme = False
    oled.fill(0)
    oled.text("SMART HOME", 0, 0)
    oled.text("ADC: " + str(valeur), 0, 12)
    oled.text("LDR: " + str(lumiere), 0, 22)
    oled.text("Temp: " + str(temperature), 0, 32)
    oled.text("Hum: " + str(humidite), 0, 42)
